title: kbjob.py ensure starts the executor when none runs, ping tells, and submit never queues for nobody
goal: kbjob.py ping exits 0 printing the pid when an executor of this host runs (its host file) and 1 when none does; ensure runs ping and, when none runs, starts serve detached (new session, stdin closed, log kb-jobs/serve.log in the git common directory), waits up to 10 s for the host file to name its pid and prints kbjob: serving pid N (exit 0, or exit 1 with the log's last line); submit calls ensure first and prints kbjob: no executor, started pid N when it had to, unless --no-ensure; login-item --print prints a macOS LaunchAgent plist (Label, ProgramArguments serve, RunAtLoad, KeepAlive, StandardErrorPath) and a systemd user unit, and writes nothing and touches no file under the home directory

run: import sys,os,tempfile,subprocess,signal,time; d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); h=tempfile.mkdtemp(); env=dict(os.environ,KB_HOST_LOCK_DIR=d,HOME=h,KB_OPERATOR="op-00000000"); s=os.path.join(d,"c.sqlite"); kb=lambda *x: subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/kbjob.py","--store",s,*x],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60); r=kb("ensure"); assert r.returncode==0, r; pid=int(r.stdout.split("pid")[1].split()[0]); assert kb("ping").returncode==0; e=kb("ensure"); assert e.returncode==0 and str(pid) in e.stdout, e; os.kill(pid,signal.SIGTERM); time.sleep(2); assert kb("ping").returncode==1; p=kb("login-item","--print"); assert p.returncode==0 and "RunAtLoad" in p.stdout and "serve" in p.stdout and os.listdir(h)==[], (p, os.listdir(h))

notes: Choice: a session starts the executor (ensure, called by submit) and a login item is only printed, because writing a LaunchAgent or a systemd unit changes the operator's host outside the clone (the operator names 'started by a session or a login item'; the print leaves the install to them, so no host-setup gate). The executor then outlives the session that started it, as dispatch --detach does for a worker (bl_dispatch.py:1051 spawn_detached, start_new_session): a background shell would die with Claude Code (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/interactive-mode#how-backgrounding-works, read 2026-11-08), so ensure starts it with its own session and never as a Bash background task. One executor per host holds an exclusive file in the host lock directory (KB_HOST_LOCK_DIR, kg_lock's mechanism, git.md:62) so two sessions' ensure never start two. Claude Code's own supervisor (claude daemon, background sessions restarted when their process exits: kb public/claude/parallel-sessions.md:84, DOC https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-view, kb retrieved 2026-10-26) hosts model sessions, not shell commands; it does not replace this executor and is not rebuilt here.
